definition: KairosDB is a database system for ingesting and querying time-series measurements.
entry_text: KairosDB is a database system for ingesting and querying time-series measurements.
example: An operations team queries hourly aggregates of sensor readings.
label: KairosDB

sources.note: The project documentation covers ingesting and querying timestamped metrics. A Cassandra-only description would be too narrow because the getting-started guide also documents an H2 backend.
